data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'ouraos' meaning 'bear'. In Greek mythology, Ursus (the bear) was a god of wilderness and protection. The name Ursin may symbolize strength, courage, and resilience. The name Ursin carries the meaning “Bear, little brown one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ursin usually hope their child will grow to embody bear, little brown one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
